title: Micron Just CRUSHED Earnings — Is MU Stock a BUY?
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Mark Roussin CPA's post-earnings reaction to Micron's quarter, published 2026-10-01. Revenue, EPS and guidance all beat, with HBM strength and a tighter 2027–28 supply outlook strengthening the underlying thesis — but Roussin stresses the stock already ran into the print, so the stance is buy the pullback, not any price. The base case: AI memory demand outgrows supply and the cycle runs long. The bear case: supply catches up, margins normalize, and the low P/E is a signal of peak earnings rather than cheapness. His only call is a conditional one: MU — CONDITIONAL_BUY (first call on record, no flip), buyer on a pullback to about $950 per share as stated. AMD and MRVL get retrospective mentions only with no current call, and a DRAM ETF is floated as alternative exposure with no explicit call recorded.

calls.price_at_call: buyer on pullback to ~$950/share (stated); no current-price buy
calls.thesis: Earnings crushed (revenue/EPS/guide beats, HBM sold forward, supply seen tighter in 2027-28) and thesis is stronger, but stock already ran and prices in the story — enter on a pullback, not at any price.
calls.base_case: AI memory demand + tight supply keep pricing/margins elevated near term; management guides next quarter higher again.
calls.bull_case: AI demand outgrows new supply (HBM/custom NV-HBM integration), so the cycle lasts far longer than prior memory cycles.
calls.bear_case: Memory stays cyclical: new fabs/supply catch up, margins normalize, and a low forward PE proves to be peak earnings.
